title: Retrieve only a worker’s assigned entity roadmap context
preconditions: Once public entity assignment exists, assign existing System S, Component C and data entity E to W; leave U unassigned. Include proposed S, implemented C with exact code evidence, and design links on each.

steps.action: Use public queries starting from W or its portable workspace assignment and page every result.
steps.expected_result: Results identify assigned S/C/E, their proposal/implementation states, code evidence and relevant design links.

steps.action: Compare the result with the complete inventory including U.
steps.expected_result: U is not represented as assigned scope; any wider context is explicitly distinguished from assigned entities.

expected_result: Workers can discover assigned technical scope without confusing it with general inventory.
